name: canvas_zoom_pan
description: Drive a Studio canvas with the gestures Q-1b added -- a wheel, a bare move, a button held across moves, a middle-button drag -- and read where the canvas ended up looking with view_state. The canvas here is the Frame Plan's logical view, because that is the one whose wheel already zooms; the Graph canvas answers the same view_state reading, and gets the zoom and pan half of this file when N-3 gives it one.
